subject: Finlytics POC: post-call recap, MAP & week 2 next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Finlytics POC: post-call recap, MAP & week 2 next steps

Hi Alex / Sam

Great to meet today thanks again for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned before the POC kickoff: 

Summary of what we agreed:
- Goal: validate Redwood Inference can serve Finlytics' batch scoring and near-real-time report generation within your latency and cost targets.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - End-to-end 95th percentile latency <= 350ms for single-request report generation (avg payload ~ 1.2k tokens)
  - Batch throughput of 40 reqs/sec with tail latency < 800ms for bulk scoring jobs
  - Total inference cost per scored record <= $0.003 (target)
  - No data leakage; logs and audit trail retained per your retention policy

Mutual Action Plan (MAP) / timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP, data access, and sign order form/PO
- Week 1 (kickoff): environment provisioning + sample dataset ingest
- Week 2: run core evaluation scenarios; baseline metrics captured
- Week 3: tuning (batching/quantization/route policies) and regression tests
- Week 4: handoff and success review

Owners:
- Finlytics: Alex (PM) / Sam (Engineering) provide sample data + access to dev environment
- Redwood: Marissa (sales lead, project lead), Rishi (solutions engineer, technical contact), David (CS, post-POC onboarding)

Attachments: I'm attaching the MAP v1 for reference (Finlytics_MAP_v1.xlsx). I'll circulate an updated MAP (v2) after we confirm dates and access.

Open questions / asks for your team before kickoff:
1) Can you confirm a dev S3 bucket or secure FTP we can use for sample data?
2) Any additional compliance constraints (IP redaction, field-level masking) beyond what we covered in the call?
3) Preferred kickoff window (we suggested Thurs 3/26 or Mon 3/30)

Next step: if the above looks good, confirm S3 access + kickoff date and I'll send the kickoff invite + updated MAP.

Thanks
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC: post-call recap, MAP & week 2 next steps

Marissa thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our expectations. Quick answers: 
- We can provision an S3 dev bucket (finlytics-poc-dev) and will share temporary creds with Rishi's account.
- Compliance: we need PII fields masked at rest; we'll provide a masked sample for the first run and discuss full redaction in week 2.
- Kickoff: Thurs 3/26 afternoon PT works best for the team.

I'll ask Sam to share the sample file by EOD 3/24. Looking forward to kickoff.

Alex
Alex Johnson | Product Lead, Data Platform
Finlytics
alex.johnson@finlytics.com | +1 (415) 444-2200

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Finlytics POC: MAP v2 + kickoff invite (3/26)

Alex / Sam

Thanks that schedule works. I attached the updated MAP (Finlytics_MAP_v2.xlsx) that includes the confirmed kickoff on Thu 3/26 2:00-3:00pm PT, plus the refined success criteria you confirmed.

Action items (owner / due):
- Finlytics: upload masked sample to finlytics-poc-dev S3 and share temp creds with rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai (Alex / Sam) due 2026-03-24 EOD
- Redwood: create dev environment, service account, and initial test harness (Rishi) due 2026-03-25
- Redwood: provide runbook and required IAM policies for ingestion (Rishi) done (attached runbook-inference-access.md)
- Sales: finalize order form and send via DocuSign after kickoff (Marissa) post-kickoff

Note on attachments: runbook-inference-access.md includes the exact S3 paths we will consume, example IAM policy, and recommended sample size (10k test records).

Looking forward invite sent for Thu 3/26 2pm PT.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC: MAP v2 + kickoff invite (3/26)

Alex / Sam

Short tech note ahead of kickoff: thanks for provisioning the finlytics-poc-dev bucket. A couple of practical items so the first run goes smoothly:

1) File format: parquet or gzipped csv is ideal; please include a small schema file (JSON) with column names and data types.
2) Example IAM policy (least privilege) attached - please apply to the temp creds.
3) If you have network constraints (VPC endpoints), let us know so we can configure egress rules for the dev env.

I'll stand up the test harness and a baseline config (single-GPU inference worker, quantization disabled for baseline) by 3/25 EOD. I'll post the run commands and expected output location to the kickoff notes.

If anything blocks you before Thu, ping me directly.

Thanks
Rishi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Finlytics POC: week 2 status nudge + quick checklist

Alex / Sam

Quick week-2 nudge great kickoff last week and thanks for getting the sample data into finlytics-poc-dev. We ran the baseline tests over the weekend and captured metrics; a short summary and asks below so we keep momentum for the evaluation: 

Baseline observations (Rishi / Redwood):
- Baseline 95th %ile latency: 520ms (single-GPU config, quantization off)
- Batch throughput: 28 reqs/sec with tail latency ~780ms for the current payload distribution
- Cost estimate (projected): $0.0044 per scored record at current config (above your target)

Recommended Week 2 actions (to hit success criteria):
- Redwood: apply controlled quantization profile and enable dynamic batching for bulk jobs (Rishi) target deliverable by 2026-03-31
- Finlytics: provide a second masked dataset with larger batch characteristics (Sam) due 2026-03-30 EOD
- Joint: schedule a 30-minute tune session to review tuned metrics (Marissa to propose slots)

Please confirm the dataset deliverable and whether Thurs 4/1 10:00-10:30am PT or Fri 4/2 2:00-2:30pm PT works for the tuning session. If you want the baseline runbook or figures, I can share the performance dashboard link.

Also: I've uploaded the updated MAP and will prepare the order form post-success review. Let me know if anything else blocks you. 

Thanks and talk soon
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
